name: agentshop
description: Machine-to-machine macroeconomic report store: 80 catalog reports plus bespoke and bundle products, generated from World Bank Open Data (CC BY 4.0) and sold per fetch in USDC over x402.

skills.name: GDP Comparison Report — Major Economies
skills.description: GDP at current US dollars for ten major economies, with period CAGR, share of group total, latest-year growth, volatility and a full year-by-year matrix.

skills.name: GDP per Capita Comparison Report
skills.description: GDP per capita at current US dollars — a productivity and living-standard proxy with CAGR, ranking and dispersion metrics.

skills.name: GDP at Purchasing Power Parity Report
skills.description: GDP at PPP in current international dollars — real economic weight adjusted for price levels, a common basis for cross-country ranking.

skills.name: GDP Growth Rate Report
skills.description: Real GDP growth (annual %) — expansion or contraction momentum, average growth, volatility and recession-year detection.

skills.name: Inflation Rate Comparison Report
skills.description: Consumer-price inflation across ten economies — monetary-policy stance, peak-inflation year and average inflation over the period.

skills.name: GDP Deflator Inflation Report
skills.description: Inflation measured by the GDP deflator — the broadest domestic price gauge, useful as a cross-check against consumer-price inflation.

skills.name: Official Exchange Rate Report
skills.description: Official exchange rate, local currency units per US dollar (period average) — a currency-valuation baseline with cumulative depreciation.

skills.name: Merchandise and Services Exports Report
skills.description: Total exports of goods and services at current US dollars — global trade positioning, export share of the group and growth.

skills.name: Merchandise and Services Imports Report
skills.description: Total imports of goods and services at current US dollars — domestic demand strength and external dependence.

skills.name: Trade Openness Report
skills.description: Trade as a share of GDP and merchandise trade as a share of GDP — how open each economy is to cross-border flows.

skills.name: Current Account Balance Report
skills.description: Current account balance at current US dollars — external surplus or deficit position, with a surplus/deficit classification per economy.

skills.name: Personal Remittances Report
skills.description: Personal remittances received at current US dollars — a hard-currency inflow that often dwarfs FDI in emerging economies.

skills.name: Foreign Direct Investment Net Inflows Report
skills.description: FDI net inflows on a balance-of-payments basis, current US dollars — cross-border capital confidence, share of group inflow and stability.

skills.name: External Debt Stock Report
skills.description: Public and publicly guaranteed external debt stocks at current US dollars — sovereign repayment-risk reference with debt accumulation trend.

skills.name: Domestic Credit to Private Sector Report
skills.description: Domestic credit to the private sector as a percentage of GDP — banking-system depth and leverage build-up.

skills.name: Equity Market Capitalization Report
skills.description: Market capitalization of listed domestic companies at current US dollars — listed-equity depth and capital-market development.

skills.name: Population Comparison Report
skills.description: Total population for ten economies with compound growth and share of the group.

skills.name: Population Growth Report
skills.description: Annual population growth and urbanisation share — the demographic trajectory behind long-run demand.

skills.name: Life Expectancy and Child Mortality Report
skills.description: Life expectancy at birth and under-5 mortality per 1,000 live births — two complementary population-health measures.

skills.name: Unemployment Rate Report
skills.description: Total unemployment as a share of the labor force — labor-market slack, best/worst year and period average.

skills.name: Labor Force Participation Report
skills.description: Labor force participation rate alongside the fertility rate — the two drivers of future labor supply.

skills.name: Income Inequality Report
skills.description: Gini index (0 = perfect equality, 100 = perfect inequality) — the standard distributional snapshot. Coverage is sparser than other indicators and is reported as such.

skills.name: Economic Structure Report — Agriculture, Industry, Services
skills.description: Value added by agriculture, industry and services as a share of GDP — three indicators rendered together to show each economy's structural composition.

skills.name: Fiscal Position Report — Tax, Debt and Education Spending
skills.description: Tax revenue, central government debt and education expenditure, all as a share of GDP — a three-indicator view of fiscal capacity.

skills.name: Research and Development Expenditure Report
skills.description: Gross domestic expenditure on R&D as a percentage of GDP — national innovation intensity.

skills.name: Resident Patent Applications Report
skills.description: Patent applications filed by residents — a direct measure of domestic inventive output. Coverage is limited to the most recent available years.

skills.name: Energy Use and Renewables Report
skills.description: Energy use per capita (kg of oil equivalent) paired with the renewable share of final energy consumption — the energy-transition scoreboard.

skills.name: CO2 Emissions per Capita Report
skills.description: Territorial CO2 emissions per capita in tonnes of CO2 equivalent — the standard climate-accounting intensity measure.

skills.name: Air Quality and Water Stress Report
skills.description: Mean PM2.5 concentration and freshwater withdrawal as a share of internal resources — environmental stress indicators relevant to operational and sovereign risk.

skills.name: Food Production Index Report
skills.description: Food production index (2014-2016 = 100) — agricultural output trajectory and food-security supply side.

skills.name: Health Expenditure Report
skills.description: Current health expenditure as a percentage of GDP — the fiscal weight of each health system.

skills.name: Military Expenditure Report
skills.description: Military expenditure as a percentage of GDP — defence burden and its trend since 2015, when several budgets inflected upward.

skills.name: Digital Adoption Report — Internet and Mobile
skills.description: Individuals using the Internet (% of population) and mobile cellular subscriptions per 100 people — digital-adoption depth for market sizing.

skills.name: Real GDP Report (Constant Prices)
skills.description: GDP at constant 2015 US dollars — volume growth stripped of price effects, the like-for-like basis for comparing economies over time.

skills.name: GNI per Capita Report (Atlas Method)
skills.description: Gross national income per capita on the World Bank Atlas method (current US$) — the income yardstick behind development classifications and lending tiers.

skills.name: High-Technology Exports Share Report
skills.description: High-technology exports as a share of manufactured exports — the clearest single proxy for where advanced manufacturing and semiconductor-grade capability sits.

skills.name: Scientific Research Output Report
skills.description: Scientific and technical journal articles published — the volume measure of national research output. Publication lags the reporting period by two to three years.

skills.name: Tertiary Education Enrolment Report
skills.description: Gross tertiary enrolment ratio — the share of the school-age cohort entering university, a leading indicator of future skilled-labour supply.

skills.name: Fixed Broadband Penetration Report
skills.description: Fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people — fixed-line connectivity depth, the infrastructure base for cloud and data-centre demand.

skills.name: Secure Internet Servers Report
skills.description: Secure Internet servers (TLS) per 1 million people — the density of encrypted online infrastructure, which tracks where digital business is actually hosted.

skills.name: Renewable Electricity Output Report
skills.description: Renewable electricity as a share of total electricity output — the power-mix transition measured at the generation stage.

skills.name: Fossil Fuel Dependence Report
skills.description: Fossil fuel consumption as a share of total energy use — the inverse of the transition, and a direct read on exposure to fuel-price shocks.

skills.name: Electricity Access Report
skills.description: Share of the population with access to electricity — the electrification baseline that conditions every downstream demand estimate.

skills.name: Applied Tariff Rate Report
skills.description: Trade-weighted mean applied tariff across all products — the measured restrictiveness of each economy's border, relevant to supply-chain and sourcing exposure. Published intermittently.

skills.name: International Tourism Receipts Report
skills.description: International tourism receipts as a share of total exports — the service-export concentration of each economy, and its pandemic-era rupture.

skills.name: Government Interest Burden Report
skills.description: Interest payments as a share of central government expense — how much of each budget is consumed servicing debt rather than funding policy. Only IMF-format reporters are covered.

skills.name: Population Ageing Report
skills.description: Population aged 65 and above as a share of the total — the ageing ratio that drives pension, healthcare and labour-supply projections.

skills.name: Extreme Poverty Report
skills.description: Poverty headcount at $2.15 a day (2017 PPP) — the headline development measure. Survey-based, so observations arrive in irregular waves rather than every year.

skills.name: Women in Parliament Report
skills.description: Proportion of national parliamentary seats held by women — a governance and institutional-quality measure used in ESG screening.

skills.name: Forest Area Report
skills.description: Forest area as a share of land area — land-use change and carbon-sink capacity, reported at multi-year intervals.

skills.name: Undernourishment Report
skills.description: Prevalence of undernourishment — the food-security stress measure, published as a model-based estimate in three-year windows.

skills.name: Hospital Beds and Physicians Report
skills.description: Hospital beds and physicians per 1,000 people — the physical capacity of each health system, a key pandemic-preparedness input.

skills.name: Military Expenditure in Dollars Report
skills.description: Military expenditure in current US dollars alongside armed-forces personnel — defence spending measured in absolute terms rather than as a GDP share.

skills.name: Growth, Inflation and Unemployment — Macro Stress Report
skills.description: Real growth, consumer-price inflation and unemployment side by side, with the pooled correlation between them — the three variables that define a stagflation or overheating call.

skills.name: Energy Transition Scoreboard
skills.description: Renewable generation share, fossil dependence, electricity access and CO2 intensity in one document, with the cross-indicator correlation matrix — the transition measured from four directions at once.

skills.name: Technology Capability Report — Exports, Research and Infrastructure
skills.description: High-technology export share, secure-server density, scientific publication volume and broadband penetration, correlated against each other — a four-axis view of where advanced capability actually accumulates.

skills.name: Fiscal Space Report — Debt, Interest and Revenue
skills.description: Central government debt, the interest share of spending and tax revenue together — whether a sovereign still has room to borrow, and how much of the budget is already spoken for.

skills.name: Demographic Shift Report — Age Structure and Growth
skills.description: The full age structure — children, working age and retired shares — plus population growth, in one document. This is the demographic dividend or drag behind every long-horizon demand forecast.

skills.name: Trade Exposure Report — Flows, Intensity and Tariffs
skills.description: Export and import intensity as a share of GDP alongside applied tariff rates — how exposed each economy is to cross-border trade, and how open its own border is.

skills.name: Human Capital Report — Education and Research Capacity
skills.description: Tertiary and secondary enrolment alongside research spending as a share of GDP — the pipeline that determines an economy's skilled-labour supply a decade out.

skills.name: Inclusion and Poverty Report — Income, Access and Services
skills.description: Extreme-poverty headcount, income inequality, financial-account ownership and basic drinking-water access together — the distributional and service-access picture behind social-risk assessments.

skills.name: Real GDP per Capita Report (Constant Prices)
skills.description: GDP per capita at constant 2015 US dollars — inflation-adjusted living-standard trajectory, the like-for-like complement to the nominal per-capita series.

skills.name: ICT Service Exports Report
skills.description: ICT service exports as a share of total service exports — the weight of high-margin digital trade in each economy's services balance.

skills.name: Urban Population Growth Report
skills.description: Annual urban population growth — the pace of city expansion behind infrastructure, housing and congestion demand.

skills.name: Life Expectancy by Sex Report
skills.description: Life expectancy at birth for females and males separately — the gender gap in longevity that the all-sex average hides.

skills.name: Government Net Lending Report
skills.description: Net lending (+) or net borrowing (-) of general government as a percentage of GDP — the bottom-line fiscal stance after all revenue and spending.

skills.name: Adult Literacy Report
skills.description: Adult literacy rate for people aged 15 and above — the foundational human-capital gate that precedes every higher-education measure.

skills.name: Nonresident Patent Applications Report
skills.description: Patent applications filed by nonresidents — the inbound side of inventive activity, complementing the resident-applicant series as a foreign-confidence signal.

skills.name: Net Energy Import Dependence Report
skills.description: Net energy imports as a share of energy use — how much of each economy's energy it must source from abroad, the flip side of the fossil-dependence measure.

skills.name: Agricultural Land Report
skills.description: Agricultural land as a share of total land area — the land base available for food and fibre production, the complement to forest-area cover.

skills.name: Cereal Yield Report
skills.description: Cereal yield in kilograms per hectare — the productivity of the grain base that feeds most calorie supply, distinct from the food-production index.

skills.name: Measles Immunization Report
skills.description: Measles immunization coverage among children aged 12-23 months — a frontline indicator of primary-health-system reach.

skills.name: Basic Sanitation Access Report
skills.description: People using at least basic sanitation services as a share of the population — the sanitation-policy counterpart to basic drinking-water access.

skills.name: 2019 Yearbook — World Economy, 2015-2019
skills.description: Year-in-review for 2019: output, real growth, consumer inflation, unemployment and population for twenty economies over the five years 2015-2019. Carries the full cross-indicator correlation matrix, per-economy trend and momentum, outlier-year flags and the year-by-year matrix, so it answers both "where does 2019 sit" and "how did it get there".
